title: Marhaba Aye Hasan
body:
Marhaba Aye Hasan Marhaba Aye Hasan
Dilbar e Fatima Jaan e Khaibar Shikan
Tujse Sar Sabz Hai Gulshan E Panjatan
Marhaba Aye Hasan Marhaba Aye Hasan
Haañ meraj e imamat ka kya puchna
Yaañ rizwañ bhi darzi banaye gaye
Banke quran ki ayat chala pairahan
Adl o khulko murawwat wafa bandagi
Amn o zohd o sakhawat sukhan parwari
Tere darbar e ismat ke hai Nau(9) ratan
Sulho ka maarkaho madine mein yaa
Karbala mein ho qasim ka izn e wigha
Bangayi hai ada teri batil shikan
Sulho karke jo payi hai fathe mubin
Sabko sulhe hudaybiya yaad aagayi
Aye madine mein rooh e nabi narazan
Dushmanane ali ko sukooñ ab kahañ
Kam na hongi sarosh unki bechayniya
Kehdo yeh nishtar e sulho ki chubhan
